root_cause: The anonymous AI-scan benchmark form sent its entries to an external Make webhook. Nothing landed in the portal database, and the benchmark projection could not count them, while the page promised a report.
prevention: Anonymous benchmark entries go to their own table benchmark_anoniem_inzendingen (RLS on, no grants for anon or authenticated) through the edge function bg-benchmark-intake, which accepts only the site origin and only the fixed branche and omvang lists. A grouped view shows a branche only from five entries. The existing frisse_blik projection is unchanged.

evidence.runtime_status: migration applied, edge function bg-benchmark-intake deployed, valid entry from site origin returned 200 and wrote a row, foreign origin returned 403; the test row is still in the table because its deletion was cancelled

limitations: No public page shows the aggregate yet; the view is for service role only
The origin check only admits www.bedrijfsgeheugen.nl, so preview deploys cannot submit
Test row (Zorg, 777 hours) still in production table
